name: Coq
note: first released in 1989; development of its Calculus of Constructions implementation began in 1984
typeSystem: Dependent types, Calculus of Inductive Constructions
runtime: The Coq kernel checks proof terms and evaluators reduce terms inside the proof assistant; extracted programs can run through OCaml, Haskell, or Scheme toolchains

runtimes.name: Coq evaluator and proof kernel
runtimes.role: Evaluators reduce terms for commands such as Compute, while the trusted kernel type-checks proof terms.

runtimes.name: Extraction (OCaml/Haskell/Scheme)
runtimes.role: Extracts verified code to a host language so it can actually run.

compilers.name: coqc
compilers.role: Compiles and checks Coq developments; Rocq 9 retains it as a compatibility command.

concurrencyModel: N/A (proof assistant; extracted code inherits target language's model)

codeExample.source:
Fixpoint factorial (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S p => n * factorial p
  end.

Compute factorial 10.
